title: Bug 3: when may the plugin take over the shared ~/.paqad-ai/current link?
context: The plugin's SessionStart currently re-points the shared link at its version-specific cache runtime whenever the link is missing, dangling, or points at an OLDER npm copy. Removing that cache (uninstall/cleanup) then dangles the link and blocks edits in every npm-onboarded project (also Codex/Gemini). The link is shared across hosts.

options.label: Only fill a missing or dangling link; never take over a link that resolves to a working npm install (npm keeps owning when present)
fill_only PLUS, when the plugin must fill, point at a stable plugin-owned location that survives cache version churn (not the version-specific cache)
Keep today's behaviour (take over an older npm copy / cache)

rationale: Owner chose fill-only + a stable plugin-owned location under CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA; never take over a working npm install
